$comment: Where this library actually lives, and nowhere it does not.
An earlier version of the generator hardcoded https://ideas.broke2builtai.com into
index.json, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, the README and the citation string.
That domain has never existed. Every one of those links was a 404 presented as a
canonical URL — which, in a library whose entire product is 'our claims are checkable',
is the worst possible thing to get wrong.
So: `site` stays null until a site is actually deployed and returns 200. While it is
null, every generated URL points at the GitHub repo, which genuinely resolves, and the
crawler files that only make sense for a website (sitemap.xml, robots.txt) are not
generated at all. Set `site` when there is something to set it to, not before.
